subject: Production telemetry stitch and escalation plan
messages:
From: Amelia Park <amelia.park@skyloft.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@skyloft.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Prod telemetry intake — quick ask and kickoff

Hi Laura —

Thanks for taking this. We're approaching a go-live for a set of critical inference endpoints and need help operationalizing observability so our ops team can own oncall. High level asks:

- Dashboards: minimum SLO, latency P95/P99, token-level cost per request
- Tracing hooks: inferred-span breakpoints for request -> model selection -> kernel path
- Error taxonomy: map transient GPU OOMs vs model mismatch vs upstream auth failures
- Alert routing: who owns which alerts and what automatic escalation looks like
- Runbooks: incident steps + rollback and model fallback guidance

Can we schedule a 60-min implementation planning session next week? I attached our current trace-tagging proposal and a sketch of the teams we expect to involve.

Attachments: skyloft-trace-proposal_v0.9.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Amelia
Senior SRE, Skyloft

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Park <amelia.park@skyloft.com>
Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@skyloft.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prod telemetry intake — quick ask and kickoff

Amelia —

Appreciate the detail. Yes, we should do a 60-min planning call to align stakeholders and produce a prescriptive implementation checklist. Proposed agenda:

1) Goals & SLOs for the first 4 weeks
2) Trace points and minimal SDK hooks (we'll provide code snippets)
3) Dashboard layout and key panels to ship with the first deploy
4) Error taxonomy draft and initial alert thresholds
5) Runbook skeleton and ownership assignments

Prework for Skyloft: share a sample request flow (JSON) and any existing trace tags. We'll take care of a runbook template and an initial alert-routing diagram.

I will loop in Marissa (on implementation), Ben (on alert routing), and Jordan (on dashboards). Suggested slots: Tue 2028-12-04 16:00 UTC or Wed 2028-12-05 10:00 UTC. Which works for you?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of CS Ops, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Prod telemetry intake — planning call + prework

Team — forwarding Amelia's request (below) and my reply. Quick roles/questions before I confirm the slot:

- Marissa: you'll run the implementation sprint and produce the runbook draft. Can you take ownership of the "runbook skeleton" deliverable by 2028-12-07?
- Ben: can you draft alert routing proposals (including paging vs email vs slack) and a first pass taxonomy mapping by 2028-12-06?
- Jordan: please sketch the dashboard layout (panels, data sources, sample queries) and include a small demo widget we can show in the call. Deadline for draft: 2028-12-06 EOD.

Also, note Skyloft asked for token-cost panels; include a panel with rolling 24h median cost/token + request distribution by model.

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Park <amelia.park@skyloft.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 17:30:00 +0000
Subject: Implementation plan + artifacts for 2028-12-11 go/no-go cadence

Amelia / Daniel —

Thanks for confirming the slot for 2028-12-11 16:00 UTC (I've created the calendar invite). Attached are the artifacts we'll use during the meeting and the immediate deliverables we committed to on the call:

Attachments included: redwood_runbook_template_v1.1.pdf (pdf), skyloft-trace-hook-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), alert-routing-proposal.drawio (drawio)

Deliverables & owners (summary):
- Runbook skeleton (Marissa) — first draft by 2028-12-07. Will include checklist: service isolation, fallback model switch, postmortem stub.
- Alert taxonomy + routing (Ben) — 2028-12-06. Will annotate alerts with severity, page target, slack channel, and SLA targets.
- Dashboard panels (Jordan) — 2028-12-06. Will supply hosted Grafana link and example queries for P50/P95/P99, token-cost heatmap, request path waterfall.
- Trace SDK hooks (Redwood eng snippets) — Laura/Jordan will provide example code and minimal instrumentation points.

Meeting objectives: align on minimum observable surface to ship with first deploy, confirm oncall roster and escalation ladder, and agree on a 2-week visibility window post-launch with daily burnups.

Notes / clarifications:
- We recommend setting alert thresholds conservatively for the first 72h and then adjusting with a suppression window to avoid noise.
- For transient GPU OOMs, default action is an automated model-fallback to the warm-quantized variant; the runbook will include the rollback trigger and signal checks.
- We'll create a short-read "alert-forensics" template to speed triage — one-pager attached to the runbook.

Action: if Skyloft can send a sample request flow and any existing trace tags before 2028-12-05, we'll incorporate them into the dashboard queries and the trace hook matrix.

Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, CS Ops — Redwood Inference
